relationships.subject: neocortical PV+ interneurons
relationships.evidence_quote: PV+ cells evoke strong synaptic inhibition in pyramidal neurons and interneurons and play critical roles in cortical function.

relationships.subject: ectopic action potentials
relationships.evidence_quote: These results establish that ectopic firing can lead to postsynaptic responses

key_findings: Over 90% of layer 2/3 PV+ interneurons in mouse OFC and S1BF fire ectopic, antidromically propagating action potentials after sustained somatic activation, independent of fast glutamatergic transmission.
SOM+ interneurons also fire EAPs less robustly, and PV+ ectopic spikes evoke IPSPs in regular-spiking neurons.
